FAQ

Questions, answered

Do I need gym experience?

No. Your plan starts exactly where you are and scales as you get stronger.

Is coaching online or in person?

Both. Train with Kenan in person or follow your plan online with weekly check-ins.

Do I have to sign up for all three pillars?

No. Start with fitness, lifestyle or fashion on its own, or go Full 360 for everything.

How fast will I see results?

Most people feel a difference within the first few weeks. Visible change depends on consistency with training, nutrition and habits.

What happens on the free consultation?

We talk through your goals, routine and style, then recommend the plan that fits — no pressure.
